about: A framework for building server apps in Node with TypeScript, used for web APIs and microservices.

prs.title: Test mocks reach services that get a fresh copy per use
prs.broken: Nest's testing tools can fill in missing parts of a test with automatic fakes. Since 11.1.20, a service that gets a fresh copy on each use was never built in such tests, and code using it got nothing.
prs.changed: The automatic fake is now treated as one shared value, so the service is built with it as before.
prs.matters: Tests that worked on 11.1.19 work again, without each project adding its own workaround.
